name: Statement 59
definition: General characteristics related to a statement which reports information for a precise date.

SenderBusinessRole.name: Sender Business Role
SenderBusinessRole.definition: Specifies the business role of the message sender and, therefore, the business relationship between the sender and the receiver (or the interests represented by them, in those cases where another entity is acting on behalf of the sender or receiver). The message is exchanged between two entities, one being the account servicer and the other the account owner, and the message can be used with either one as the sender.

QueryReference.name: Query Reference
QueryReference.definition: Identification of the query message sent to request this statement.

StatementIdentification.name: Statement Identification
StatementIdentification.definition: Reference common to all pages of the statement.

StatementDateTime.name: Statement Date Time
StatementDateTime.definition: Date and time when the statement was created.

StatementPeriod.name: Statement Period
StatementPeriod.definition: Date period for which the statement was created.

FrequencyGranularity.name: Frequency Granularity
FrequencyGranularity.definition: Granularity of the frequency used for the reporting.

UpdateType.name: Update Type
UpdateType.definition: Specifies whether the statement is complete or contains changes only.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity or updated information reported in the statement.

FrequencyGranularityGuideline.definition: FrequencyGranularity should be within the limits of the Frequency, such as Frequency equals Monthly and FrequencyGranularity equals Daily.
